heading: This Afternoon
text: Clouds gradually increasing south; mostly cloudy north, with the chance of a shower, mainly over high terrain, and in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs in the low to mid 50s from the international border down to around Route 15, mid 50s to around 60 south to Route 4, and mid to upper 60s from Route 4 southward. West to northwest west winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Gradual clearing. Lows from the mid 20s to lower 30s, with some mid 30s near Lake Champlain and some lower 20s in northern cold hollows. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming north and diminishing, except gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny. Valley highs in the low to mid 50s in the south, and mid 40s to around 50 north. North winds 5 to 15 mph.
